note: Kirksville (the only Adair County city known to zone) publishes its zoning map as a static 24x36 PDF and an interactive IntegrityGIS viewer. The viewer's backing ArcGIS service could not be reached and no zoning layer appears in the county's integritygis assessor MapServer listings. Adair County's own resolution 2026-1 indicates no county zoning regulations for large-scale technology facilities. No queryable zoning district service was found in ArcGIS Online or Hub searches.
